answer: Require each agent to bond refundable stake before its attestations count; a sybil must fund N separate bonds, so forging N identities costs N times the deposit instead of near-zero. Peers treat an unbonded agent signal as noise. Each bond rests on a slashing ledge: one provably false attestation tips it over and burns the deposit. Picture the cost curve as a steep violet wall where cloning identities scales linearly in locked capital, making large sybil fleets economically irrational.
